item.title: Johnson-Massie feud boils over: "Why are we taking days off our calendar?"
item.description: Mike Johnson's decision to send the House home early again is fueling an increasingly bitter feud with Rep. Thomas Massie (R-Ky.) over whether the chamber should remain in session.

item.title: Experts warn of looming AI-driven hacking threat
item.description: Security experts say a major wave of AI-powered cyberattacks is coming, posing a more urgent risk than theoretical concerns.

item.title: Trump to meet Gulf leaders on Iran next week
item.description: President Trump is expected to meet Gulf leaders during the UN General Assembly in New York next Tuesday to discuss the issue.

item.title: States prepare for possible ICE presence at polls
item.description: After hints from the Trump administration about sending ICE agents to polling places this fall, state officials across the country are making preparations.
